title: fix(ci): restore cold checkout and Control UI startup validation
body:
Related: #150465

## What Problem This Solves

Main CI fails when the Control UI startup bundle exceeds its existing size limit or the cold-worktree fixture omits a newly imported source helper. Copied PR-wrapper dependencies also need CI coverage when their source changes.

## User Impact

Control UI startup downloads less JavaScript while Usage labels and interactions stay unchanged. Cold-worktree tests exercise the complete real script dependency chain, and future PR-wrapper source changes select provisioning proof automatically. No configuration, dependency versions, thresholds, allowances, or snapshots change.

## Why This Change Was Made

Move 135 Usage-only English strings into the existing lazy catalog mechanism, preserving shared labels and complete translation composition. Add the missing bundled-source helper to the cold fixture. Derive the provisioning test watch from the existing wrapper inventory and verify that every extracted component includes its eager runtime imports. The inventory's three missing entries are already repaired on main; this change protects that repair without replacing normal source-owned tests.

## Evidence

Prior failures: [main startup budget](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35167537979/job/105033483035) and [cold-worktree fixture](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35170054941/job/105039706400).

The integrated production UI build measures **361,237 bytes startup gzip**, leaving **1,351 bytes** below the unchanged 362,588-byte limit, with seven startup requests. The original same-source comparison reduced startup gzip by **1,494 bytes**. The complete 621,923-byte English catalog and key order remain identical, and the Usage fragment stays in the deferred page bundle.

The UI files are byte-identical to the reviewed source that passed 251 focused Usage/i18n tests and all 10 bundled Usage analysis E2E scenarios. The integrated CI-planning, cold-worktree, and native provisioning suites pass: **135 tests passed**, with one existing Linux-only case skipped on macOS. The APFS cold/warm and sparse-transition case passed in 81.3 seconds. The full selected formatting, type, i18n, lint, dead-export, and boundary checks pass. Fresh combined P0–P2 review is clean.

Before/after screenshots show the same synthetic Usage scenario; both PNGs and the owning UI source are unchanged.
